reason: This is a broad, cross-cutting change to cancel/kill behavior touching core executor paths, server/session handling, sqlkiller/memory control, coprocessor execution, and statistics/analyze flows. Query kill/cancel semantics are central runtime and session/protocol correctness surfaces, and regressions here can cause incorrect query termination, leaked work, stuck execution, or wrong interruption of transactional/statistics tasks. The scope and module spread are well above a routine fix.
